entities.name: Balaguer Era (1966–1996)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Joaquín Balaguer, a former Trujillo associate, dominated Dominican politics for three decades, serving as president for 22 years across seven terms. His rule combined economic modernization with authoritarian tendencies, political repression, and massive construction projects.
